The daemon says no

The save banner’s twin. It arrives and leaves identically — same slide, same ring draw, same horns, same eyes landing on 900 ms — then shuts both eyes and shakes its head instead of winking. Press play with the sound on; the animation and the audio are driven off one clock, so what you see is what ships.

A/B them — the first 900 ms should feel the same

The tritone is the moment it commits. At 320 ms the error sound is the same sound as the save banner’s — nothing has failed yet, the card is still arriving. At 900 ms, where the save banner resolves up a perfect fifth to B3, this one lands a tritone on B♭3 and never comes home: the exit walks down past the root to D3 instead of returning to it. The shake itself is silent, for the same reason the wink is.
